tasks.name: Stop the .git growth (C4)
tasks.description: No tests required: git index change + debris deletion verified by checks that fail if the file stays tracked. Exact commands: human plan Task 5. Operator quits ChatGPT.app first; no git process running. Commit built in a TEMP index (GIT_INDEX_FILE=/private/tmp/ra-untrack.index, read-tree HEAD) so neither the modified 3.65 GB working file nor unrelated staged work enters the commit; never `git commit -- <paths>`. Then mirror the 2 changes in the real index. Local commit only, no push, no trailers. If a guard blocks: stop and report exact message.

steps.description: No git process running (pgrep -lx git -> exit 1, else stop and ask); then delete debris (two find commands per human plan Task 5 Step 2); tmp_obj_* leftovers out of scope
steps.expected: Paths printed; then index.stash.* deletion likewise.

steps.description: Record real-index staged set; append .gitignore line (Edit tool); temp-index read-tree HEAD / rm --cached db / add .gitignore / diff --cached (expect exactly D db + M .gitignore, else stop); commit from temp index with no pathspec; mirror rm --cached + add .gitignore in real index; delete temp index. Exact commands: human plan Task 5 Step 3.
steps.expected: Commit with exactly 2 changes; no push.
